contradictions.description: VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY.AVAILABLE formula = OPENING_BALANCE + ACCRUED - USED + ADJUSTMENT (omits PENDING). LEAVE_BALANCES.AVAILABLE virtual column = OPENING_BALANCE + ACCRUED - USED + ADJUSTMENT - PENDING. Both defined in DA; BA process flows and AA call-flow map (CF-003 step 5) use the virtual column (with PENDING). All three reporting consumers — the view, the virtual column, and PKG_LEAVE — give different available-balance figures for any employee with a pending request.
contradictions.entity: VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY.AVAILABLE vs LEAVE_BALANCES.AVAILABLE virtual column formula

contradictions.description: Hire date future limit is stated as three different values across tracks: AA (HRMS_EMPLOYEE form WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM) enforces SYSDATE+90; DA (TRG_EMP_BEFORE_INSERT, confirmed DDL authoritative per DA reviewer) enforces SYSDATE+180; BA process flow documents 90 days for the UI path and notes both limits with no declared tie-breaker. TA flags this as DISC-001.
contradictions.entity: EMPLOYEES.HIRE_DATE maximum future date (90 days in form vs 180 days in trigger)

contradictions.description: EMPLOYEE_HISTORY column structure differs between DA and AA: DA DDL (01_core_tables.sql) declares typed columns EFFECTIVE_DATE, OLD_DEPT_ID, NEW_DEPT_ID, OLD_JOB_ID, NEW_JOB_ID, OLD_MANAGER_ID, NEW_MANAGER_ID, OLD_SALARY, NEW_SALARY, OLD_LOCATION, NEW_LOCATION. AA component COMP-020 (TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE) references flat-string columns CHANGE_DATE, OLD_VALUE, NEW_VALUE which do not exist in the DDL. Exactly one of these will raise ORA-00904 on every EMPLOYEES UPDATE. DA reviewer confirms DDL is authoritative (DISC-002).
contradictions.entity: EMPLOYEE_HISTORY column layout (DDL typed columns vs trigger flat-string columns)

contradictions.description: PKG_EMPLOYEE.rehire_employee is listed in AA component-registry (COMP-001) as a confirmed public method with no non-functional flag in risk_flags. BA Pass 2 explicitly marks 'Rehire Employee' as entirely non-functional — TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE raises -20503 on TERMINATED→ACTIVE status change, which is exactly what rehire_employee executes. TA also documents this defect. AA's component-registry incorrectly classifies a broken procedure as healthy.

DA schema-catalogue.json extraction metadata declares tables: 30. TA Stack Scout section heading states 'Total tables: 35 (confirmed from DDL).' A 5-table discrepancy exists between the two tracks with no reconciliation. TA's own section headings also contain internal inconsistencies ('Core Tables — 6 tables' with 8 rows in the table body; 'Payroll Tables — 8 tables' with 9 rows), suggesting the TA count of 35 may itself be unreliable.
contradictions.entity: Total HRMS schema table count (DA: 30 vs TA: 35)

contradictions.description: BA document version fragmentation: BA_Deep_Analyst_FINAL.md at repository root declares 120 business rules (BR-01–BR-120, 7 domains). The merged file at results/Business_Analysis/BA_Deep_Analyst.md declares 140 rules (BR-01–BR-140). BA_Deep_Analyst_Edge.md declares 87 rules. No canonical version is designated. Any cross-track reference to 'the BA output' is ambiguous because rule counts differ by 20–53 depending on which file is used.
contradictions.entity: Business rule count across BA document versions (120 vs 140 vs 87)

contradictions.description: AA component-registry (COMP-002 PKG_PAYROLL risk_flags) states 'SALARY_BASIS always ANNUAL regardless of input.' DA schema-catalogue documents SALARY_RECORDS.SALARY_BASIS with CHECK constraint IN ('ANNUAL','HOURLY') and default 'ANNUAL', implying HOURLY is a valid and expected value. BA payroll process flow does not document hourly-basis employees at all. DA schema supports hourly employees; AA confirms HOURLY is silently overwritten; BA has no business rule for hourly-basis payroll calculation.
contradictions.entity: SALARY_RECORDS.SALARY_BASIS HOURLY value — schema supports it, code silently overrides it, BA ignores it

summary: 18 gaps and 7 contradictions found. Most critical gaps: (1) USER_CREDENTIALS table is referenced across BA and TA/AA for password authentication but has no DDL in DA; (2) EMPLOYEE_DEPENDENTS and EMPLOYEE_BANK_ACCOUNTS are fully modelled in DA with business-significant columns (BENEFITS_ENROLLED, PRENOTE_SENT, split-deposit logic) yet have zero BA business rules and no AA package coverage — the dependent management and direct-deposit domains are entirely undocumented in BA and AA; (3) PKG_INTEGRATION.import_time_attendance has a procedure in AA but DA has no target table to receive the imported records. Most critical contradictions: VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY available-balance formula contradicts the LEAVE_BALANCES authoritative virtual column formula (tracked in DA DISC-003 but unresolved across tracks); rehire_employee is classified as a working method in AA but is confirmed broken in BA and TA; EMPLOYEE_HISTORY column layout in DA DDL is incompatible with the trigger logic documented in AA.
